units.source_text: 为了答谢她的好意，走进她房间里，对她说道：“我正在忧伤之时，得你赠诗分外喜慰。”

en.t: To thank her for her kindness, he went into her room and said to her, "At a time when I was sunk in sorrow, your poem brought me extraordinary comfort."

units.source_text: 薰大将一向矜庄持重，举止端详，不肯随便出入于侍女之室，是个高贵人物。

en.t: General Kaoru was always reserved and dignified, grave in his conduct, and unwilling to come and go casually from a serving woman's room; he was a man of noble bearing.

units.source_text: 而小宰相君的居处十分简陋，又窄又浅，便是宫中所谓“局”的小屋。

en.t: Lady Kozaisho's quarters, however, were extremely plain, narrow and shallow, the little room known in the palace as a "tsubone."

units.source_text: 薰大将走近那拉门口时，小宰相君觉得不好意思。

en.t: When General Kaoru came near the sliding door, Lady Kozaisho felt embarrassed.

units.source_text: 但她并不过分自卑，不慌不忙，巧妙应对。

en.t: But she did not become overly self-effacing; she remained calm and composed, and answered him with tact.

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“此人比我所爱的那人更加优雅可爱呢！

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "This woman is even more graceful and lovely than the one I loved.

units.source_text: 为什么在这里当宫女呢？

en.t: Why is she serving here as a palace woman?

units.source_text: 最好当了我的侍妾，让我来照管她吧。”

en.t: It would be best to make her my mistress and let me look after her myself."

units.source_text: 但他这秘密企图绝不让人知道。

en.t: But he would never let anyone know of this secret design.
